language_scope: English only for publication; unspecified/mixed languages audit-only
normalization: statement L2; equal-weight statement mean per country; country L2
duplicate_policy: DF over unique exact text hashes; remove duplicate text within country before pooling; cross-country duplicate text blocks publication
unknown_term_policy: discard from fixed feature matrix; retain eligible-token OOV counts; zero rows have undefined similarity
reference_policy: bootstrap once per provenance/genre/language namespace, then frozen; never refit during transform
